results.title: AI phone assistant that makes real calls · Arlo
results.content:
### Can an AI assistant actually make phone calls for me?

Yes. Arlo places live outbound calls — confirming appointments, chasing a supplier about a missing order, following up on a quote — and handles the back-and-forth itself, getting through phone menus, waiting on hold and leaving a voicemail if nobody picks up. You ask for it by text or in Slack, and when the call ends Arlo reports what happened in the same thread, where you can ask follow-up questions.

### Can it answer my incoming calls too?

You can call your Arlo number to ask for help by voice. Arlo also makes outbound calls for you. It does not answer or screen calls from other people on your behalf.

### What happens after the call ends? [...] ### Will it commit to things on my behalf without asking?

No. Calls follow the brief you give it. Arlo tells you who it's calling and why before it dials, introduces itself as your AI assistant, and sticks to that brief on the call. It texts you a question mid-call when you've told it to check with you, and every call is written to an audit trail with its transcript.

### Can it reschedule an appointment for me?

Ask Arlo to check replacement times and state whether it may confirm a change. Keep the original booking until a replacement is confirmed. If there is a fee, identity check or decision outside your brief, Arlo needs your input.

Your time back, even when there’s a queue. [...] ### What happens after the call ends?

Arlo brings the outcome back to the conversation and keeps the call transcript. You can ask follow-up questions or ask it to update your calendar and take care of the next step.

### How much does an AI phone call cost?

A call costs 25¢ a minute of talking, and about 1.5¢ a minute on hold. It comes out of your plan's monthly usage, the same usage that pays for texts, Slack, research and drafting, so there is no separate calling plan and no bundle of call hours to buy in advance. The free trial includes calls too, with $25 of usage.

results.title: 11 Best AI Phone Assistants That Call for You (2026)
results.content:
Personal errands on a Pixel 11: Gemini Call for Me. Already in Instinct or Muse: use their calling as it reaches you. Rather a person made the awkward calls: Fo. Want your current agent to dial: Vapi’s free beta, or Bland for a number that also takes calls and texts. On an iPhone: Call Screening and Hold Assist save time, but you still talk.

## FAQ

### Can AI make phone calls for me?

Yes. Gemini’s Call for Me (Pixel 11 beta), Muse, Fo, Arlo and Martin call businesses for you, Instinct and Tab do for early users, and Vapi or Bland give an existing assistant a phone. For calls that are work, Carly calls from your business number and logs every call with a transcript.

### Can ChatGPT make phone calls? [...] # 11 Best AI Phone Assistants That Call for You (2026)

You want to say “call them back and book Thursday” and get on with your day. Or have someone pick up when you can’t.

Since mid-September Google, Meta, Instinct, Vapi, Wajo and Tab have all shipped AI that dials. Most of it is beta, US-only, and built for one person’s errands. Hark Pro, out October 6, can’t place calls yet.

Short answer: Carly is the best AI assistant for phone calls that are part of your work. It makes calls from your business number, answers that number when you can’t, texts from it, books callers on your team’s Google and Outlook calendars, and follows up by text or email. Run it from inside ChatGPT or Claude: copy one prompt, grab a number, and you’re live.

## The three jobs a phone assistant has to do [...] Then call the number yourself and read the log (tutorial). Calling rules for leads are in AI outbound calling.

Best for: anyone whose calls are work (leads, customers, vendors, appointment confirmations)

Get started, or see the best AI receptionists if answering your line is the main job.

## 2. Gemini Call for Me (Pixel 11)

Launched September 24 as an early preview, Call for Me is the first mainstream assistant that does the whole call. Gemini dials from your own number, says it’s an AI assistant from Google calling on a recorded line on your behalf, works the phone menu and waits on hold while you follow a live transcript.

Best for: Pixel 11 owners with errands to US businesses
